roles.name: --accent
roles.purpose: a highlighted menu row in an overlay; the light outline and ghost hovers take it

roles.name: --accent-foreground
roles.purpose: text on an accent surface

roles.name: --border
roles.purpose: frames and lines: a 2px frame on a resting container and the splits between its sections, a 1px line on controls and between rows

roles.name: --card-foreground
roles.purpose: text on a card

roles.name: --category-1
roles.purpose: a first kind of thing — text and border of its badge

roles.name: --category-1-muted
roles.purpose: the fill of a first-kind badge

roles.name: --category-2
roles.purpose: a second kind of thing — text and border of its badge

roles.name: --category-2-muted
roles.purpose: the fill of a second-kind badge

roles.name: --danger
roles.purpose: a state in trouble — Expired, aging 61+ days — as text or an icon

roles.name: --danger-muted
roles.purpose: a danger badge's fill

roles.name: --data
roles.purpose: an operational, informational state — Posted, Monitoring

roles.name: --data-muted
roles.purpose: an informational state badge's fill

roles.name: --destructive
roles.purpose: a destructive action — a delete or discard button, a destructive menu item

roles.name: --foreground
roles.purpose: body text on the canvas

roles.name: --line-height-caption
roles.purpose: the 11px and 12px roles: metadata, badges, field errors, nav items, the status strip
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --muted-foreground
roles.purpose: secondary text — hints, metadata. L .50 is the lightest that clears WCAG AA (4.5:1) on every surface muted text sits on, muted and accent included

roles.name: --neutral-state-border
roles.purpose: the outline of a settled or neutral state's badge

roles.name: --neutral-state-muted
roles.purpose: the fill of a settled or neutral state's badge — Draft, Closed, Inactive user

roles.name: --primary-ink
roles.purpose: the brand colour as TEXT or a glyph on a surface — a link, a record's mark. The fill above carries white text; in dark it is too deep to read as text itself, so this lifts it.

roles.name: --primary-muted
roles.purpose: a quiet brand tint — a selected row, a panel's header band, and the default badge's fill: the human's decision — the default badge is tinted brand blue so it never looks like the primary button

roles.name: --radius-pill
roles.purpose: a fully round end: an avatar, a switch, a radio

roles.name: --radius-stamp
roles.purpose: a mark inside content: a badge, a match highlight, a checkbox

roles.name: --ring
roles.purpose: the focus ring

roles.name: --secondary
roles.purpose: the secondary button fill — a neutral grey, distinct from accent

roles.name: --secondary-foreground
roles.purpose: text on a secondary fill

roles.name: --secondary-hover
roles.purpose: a secondary fill under the pointer

roles.name: --step-12
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: --success
roles.purpose: a good state — Active, Open — as text or an icon

roles.name: --success-muted
roles.purpose: a success badge's fill

roles.name: --warning
roles.purpose: a state needing attention — Inactive, aging 1–60 days — as text or an icon

roles.name: --warning-muted
roles.purpose: a warning badge's fill

roles.name: --weight-strong
roles.purpose: a row title, a field label, a button label, a badge, a dialog title
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.

roles.name: type-badge
roles.purpose: a compact status or count mark
roles.value: font-size: var(--step-12); font-weight: var(--weight-strong); line-height: var(--line-height-caption)
roles.why: A back office is compact by definition: its gaps, its field and row sizes, its text sizes and weights and its page edge are part of what it is.
